description: This file defines the TalkModeController class, which manages the talk mode state, including enabling/disabling, updating phases and levels, pausing, stopping speech, and exiting talk mode. It interacts with other components such as TalkOverlayController, TalkModeRuntime, GatewayConnection, and AppStateStore.

classes.name: TalkModeController
classes.description: Controller class managing the state and behavior of the talk mode feature, including toggling, phase updates, pausing, and stopping speaking.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the talk mode, updating the overlay and runtime accordingly, and managing wake listener state.

methods.name: updatePhase
methods.description: Updates the current phase of the talk mode and informs the overlay and gateway connection.

methods.name: updateLevel
methods.description: Updates the level indicator in the overlay.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Pauses or resumes talk mode, updating the overlay and notifying runtime and connection components.

methods.name: togglePaused
methods.description: Toggles the paused state of the talk mode.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Stops the ongoing speech within talk mode, with a reason parameter.

methods.name: exitTalkMode
methods.description: Exits the talk mode by disabling it via the shared app state store.
